translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: SAN MARCOS
book.title: An alhua’ cau thuchath c’al an t’ocat inic Marcos

content: Xe’ets a Jesús ti Nazaret
Taley tixc’an a Jesús tin q’uima’ a Jairo, ta huichiy tim bichou junax c’al in exobalilchic.

Taley pel i sábado ani c’uajat ti exobchix a Jesús tin tiyopanil an Israelchic tim bichou. Yantalam i inic in ats’anchal ani in lej jic’panchal in exobchixtal. In uluchic: ―¿Ju’ta tin ela’ patal axe’ xi cau axe’ xi inic? ¿C’al jita’ ti pithanchat ja in lej tsalpathtal, ani jant’ini’ tin lej ejtohual quin t’aja’ i labith t’ajbilab?

I exlalq’ui ti thacum te’. Pel in tsacamil a Maria, ani pel in ebchal a Jacobo, ani a José, ani a Judas, ani a Simón. Ani u c’uajil jaye teje’ c’al huahua’ in uxum ebchalchic. Antsana’ u t’apchinal in tsalap nixe’ xi inicchic yab in tequeth exlanchi in lej ey a Jesús.

Jaxtam a Jesús in ucha’chic: ―U c’ac’nab axi caulome c’al a Dios abal ju’tamq’ui c’al tim patal an inicchic, expith yab u c’ac’nab c’al in at bichou, ani c’al in at ja’ubchic xits’al, ani c’al axi tin cuete’ q’uima’.
Cum yab u belnal a Jesús c’al an inicchic tihua’ tim bichou, jaxtam yabats in t’ajal yan i labith t’ajbilab taja’. Expith in mo’cal in c’ubac c’al tsab ox i ya’ul abal quin jeltha’.
In jic’pal a Jesús abal jale’ yab u belchinal in lej ey. Aba ani’, bel xe’ets ti exobchix al i bichouchic axi utat taja’ tim bichou.
A Jesús in abal axi lajuj tsab in exobalil ti olnom

Taley a Jesús in caniy ca chich c’al jaja’ axi lajuj tsab in exobalilchic abal quin aba’ tin t’ojlabil. In ucha’chic ca xe’tsin ti tsabchic tin eb. Im pitha’chic i eyaltalab abal ti canchix c’al i at’ax teneclab.
In ucha’chic quin ne’tha’ expith i cuayablab tam ne’ets ti bel. Yab quin ne’tha’ i morral, ni i pan, ni i tumin.
Quin xe’tsintha’ i pajablab axi yab lej huinat alhua’. Quin ne’tha’ expith juncats i toltom ax in ca’quimits.
In uchayechic más i cau antse’: ―Al an ata jun ti quit bats’uhuat, tats quit junini’ c’uajiy ma tam ti ne’etsits quit cale al nixe’ xi bichou.

Max jun i bichou yab ti bats’uhual ani yab ti ats’anchal a cahuintal, tam quit tixc’an taja’ c’al jaja’chic. Am pojoth jahuats ca tha’u ta acan al nixe’ xi bichou, ca tininiy tam ne’ets quit tixc’an. Antsana’ ta ca t’aja’ abal quin alhua’ tso’obna’ an inicchic taja’ abal yab alhua’ in t’ajamal cum im pojcanchamal in cahuintal a Dios. Lej chubax nan tu uchalchic abal jaja’chic ne’ets ca c’athpich yajchiquiyat tam quim baju an q’uicha tam ca ts’ejca c’al a Dios. Ma an Sodomajibchic ani an Gomorrajibchic c’al im pojcaxtal axi ti biyal yab ne’ets ca c’athpich yajchiquiyat jant’ini’ jaja’chic axi yab ti bats’uhual.
Tam ti antsana’its uchanchic in exobalil c’al a Jesús, ta c’aletschic. Xe’ets in olnanchalchic in cahuintal a Dios c’al an inicchic ca jic’tson c’al in hualab ani ca huenc’on c’al a Dios.
Jaye in canchal i at’ax teneclab an inicchic, ani in mauchal i aceite yantalam i ya’ul inicchic ani in jelthalchic.
Tsemtha a Juan pujax

Cum lej t’iloxnanchab in labith t’ajbilchic a Jesús c’al jat’hua’ tim patal an inicchic, olchinal jaye an ts’ale Herodes. In ulu jaja’ tamna’: ―Axe’ xi inic jats a Juan pujax axi tsemenecac ani xo’ ejthachits, ani jaxtam in cua’al in lej tsap quin t’aja’ i labith t’ajbilab.
Talchic i inic taja’ in ulu: ―Ja’its jaja’ pel an caulome a Elias. Q’ue’atchic in ulu: ―Ja’its pel i caulome c’al a Dios ejtil axi biyal caulome c’al a Dios.

Tam tin ats’a’ a Herodes jant’ini’ tin ulu an inicchic taja’, tam jaja’ in ulu: ―Ojni’ ja’its jaja’ pel a Juan pujax axi tsemenecac ani xo’ ejthachits. Ja’its jaja’ ax u aba’ an cau ca muts’inchat in oc’.

Antsana’ tin ulu a Herodes cum ti jayq’ui’ in aba’ an cau ca baliyat a Juan ti huic’axte ani ca huic’an c’al i calaniyo pat’al, cum a Herodías antsana’ in le’ ca t’ajchinchat a Juan. Nixe’ a Herodías pel in tomquil a Felipe axi’ pel in ebchal a Herodes. Ani juncunenec jaja’ c’al a Herodes.
Uchanits ti jayq’ui’ a Herodes c’al a Juan antse’: ―Yab alhua’ ax a t’ajal a co’onchal in tomquil a ebchal.
Jats ti lej tsacuy a Herodías ani in lej le’ max quin t’ajat tsemtha’ a Juan. Tocat yab in ejtou quin tsemtha’.

Ani cum a Herodes in exla’its abal a Juan pel i pututh inic t’ocat ti xe’ets, jaxtam in c’ac’nal. Ani yab in jilchi a Herodías quin t’ajchi jant’o yab alhua’ a Juan. Ani lej canat a Herodes quin ats’a’ an cau jahua’ in olnal a Juan, aba ani’ yab in alhua’ ejtiyal.

Talbel im baju a q’uicha tam ti a Herodías in ejtou quin ts’ejca’ an cau c’al a Herodes jant’ini’ ta ca tsemthanchat a Juan. Pel a q’uicha tam tin t’ajal an ajib tin tamub a Herodes. Mulcunenequits ti c’apul c’al i ts’alat c’apnel patal an oc’lecchic, ani an eyalchic, ani axi q’ue’atchic c’athpich pulic in ey ti bichoulom Galilea.

Otsits in ts’ic’achil a Herodías taja’ jun tu c’apulchic, ani bixom. Ani a Herodes in tsu’u lej q’uijith ti bixom an ts’ic’ach. Jaye q’uijith tsu’tab ti bixom c’al axi taja’chic in at juntal c’apul c’al jaja’. Tam uchan an ts’ic’ach c’al a Herodes: ―Tiquin conchi jahua’ tata’ ca le’na’, ani nan ne’ets tu pitha’.
Tam in lej cuba’ tim ba’ ti chubax a Herodes abal lej chubax ne’ets quim pitha’ an ts’ic’ach jahuaquitsq’ui ta ca conchin, ma tam ts’ejel jahua’ in cua’al ti ts’ale max quin le’nanchi.
Tam calpan an ts’ic’ach, ta c’ale quin conoy in mim antse’: ―¿Jant’o cu conchi? Toc’tsin in mim: ―Ca conchi in oc’ a Juan pujax.
Tam otscan junil an ts’ic’ach jun ti c’uajat an ts’ale Herodes, ani in ucha’: ―Ma xohue’itscua’ u le’ in oc’ a Juan pujax al jun i talab.
Tam lej t’e’pinal an ts’ale c’al nixe’ xi cau. Bel cum im cubamalits tim ba’ ti chubax ani jaye ats’anchamejits jahua’ in ulu c’al an ajibalchic, jaxtam ne’ets quim putu c’al jahua’ in ulumalits.
Thubat an ts’ale in aba’ an soldado abal ca chanchin in oc’ a Juan.
Ta c’ale ba’ an huic’axte’. In muts’inchi in oc’ a Juan ani in chanchi a Herodes al jun i talab. Tam a Herodes im pithanchi an ts’ic’ach ani an ts’ic’ach in huat’banchi in mim.
Tam tin ats’a’ in exobalilchic a Juan abal jaja’ tsemthachits, tam c’alechic quim penchi in inictal. In nenchi abal quin joliy.
A Jesús im pijchal bo’ mil i inicchic
Jun a q’uicha talbel tamcun in abathualejilchic a Jesús c’al jaja’, in tala’ t’ilchal jahua’ in t’ajamalchic ani jahua’ in exobchamalchic.
Tam uchanchic c’al a Jesús: ―Huana cu c’ale tu coyol hue’ al jun i c’uajattalab pil. Antsana in ulu, cum yabats u jolc’anal jaja’chic ca c’aputs c’al tin ebal axi yantalam an inicchic ax u ulelel.
Tam ta c’ale al i tan a Jesús junax c’al in exobalilchic. Ne’ets al i c’uajattalab pil.
Ani tsu’tab abal pel a Jesús tihua’ ne’ets junax c’al in exobalilchic. Tam athlatschic yan i inicchic, ani oc’ox ulits jaja’chic tihua’ jun ti ne’ets a Jesús ani in exobalilchic.

Tam ti calejits a Jesús al an tan, tam in tsu’u jun i pulic cuenel i inicchic muthat taja’. In yajnanchalchic cum xe’ets ejtil i cuenel i ovejachic yab jita’ ta ca beletna. Tam in ts’i’quiyal quin exobchichic c’al yan i cau:
Taley lej huaclejits, ani chich in exobalilchic quin ucha’ a Jesús: ―Lej huaclejits ani ni jita’ yab u c’uajil teje’.
Cum yab jant’o in cua’alchic an mulcunel quin c’apu, ca ucha’ ca c’ale ti al i q’uimathlomchic ani ti al i bichouchic axi utat abal quin ts’a’iy jant’o quin c’apu.
Toc’tsin a Jesús: ―Tata’chic ca pijchi an mulcunel. Toc’tsin jaja’chic: ―Auxe’ max ca lejey qui pijchi an mulcunel c’al tsab i bo’ inic i tumin denario i pan qui ts’a’iy.
Tam a Jesús in ucha’chic: ―Quit c’ale ca tsu’u jay i pan a cua’al. Tam tin tsu’uhuits, huichc’on junil ani in olchi a Jesús antse’: ―I cua’al bo’ i panchic ani tsab i to’ol.
Tam a Jesús in ucha’ an mulcunel ca buxcan ti cuenel ti cuenelchic ba’ an tsabal jun ti hua’ats i tsacam tom.
Ani tats ti buxcanchic ti bo’ inic ti junchic i cuenelchic ani ti tsab inic c’al lajuj ti junchic i cuenelchic.

Tam a Jesús im bats’u axi bo’ i pan ani axi tsab i to’ol. Tam in met’al ti eb ani im pitha’ i c’ac’namal yan c’al a Dios. Taley in mu’u am pan ani im pitha’ in exobalilchic quin huat’banchi an mulcunel. Jaye im pitha’chic an to’ol quin huat’banchi an mulcunel.
C’aputs patal an mulcunel ani ajhuejits.
Taley in exobalilchic a Jesús in thaya’ an jilc’omach pan ani an jilc’omach to’ol, ma lajuj tsab i t’ocnal t’uchichithits.
Ajith an inic pel i bo’ mil axi c’aputs.
Belal a Jesús eblim an ja’
Taley a Jesús in ucha’ in exobalilchic ca otsits al an tan ani ca oc’chith c’ale ti Betsaida jum poq’ue’ am pulic lejem, ani jaja’ ne’ets ca jilc’on ne’ets quin aba’ ca c’alets an mulcunel.
Tam tin aba’its ca c’ale, tam jaja’ c’athiy al jun i bolchal ca olon.
Aclejits ani an tan ne’ets tam ts’ejel al am pulic lejem, ani a Jesús c’uajate ba’ an tsabal.

In tsu’u a Jesús abal u tanc’uiyab an tan c’al i tsapic ic’ ani lej t’ojlabits quin xalu an ja’ abal quim beltha’ an tan. Tal chuthelits ani c’ale a Jesús c’al in exobalilchic, ne’ets belbel eblim an ja’. In t’aja’ ejtil max ne’ets quin huat’anchi in exobalilchic.
Tam tsu’tab ne’ets belbel eblim an ja’, ani u tsalpanchab hualam pel i labax. Tam thajnal in exobalilchic.
Patal jaja’chic t’elelel in ichich c’al i jiq’ueltalab. Tam a Jesús in tauna’ in ucha’chic: ―Tiquin lej tsapnanaychic ta ichich. Yab quit jiq’ueychic cum nana’its jats ax in tal c’al tata’chic.
Tam otsits a Jesús c’al jaja’chic al an tan, ani yabats juchuchul an ic’ tamna’. Ani lej jic’pab a Jesús c’al in exobalilchic cum in coytha’ an ic’.
Aba ani’ in tsu’umalits a Jesús quin yanetha’ i pan, yabaye in lej exlanchal in lej tsap. T’ujbabathechic in ichich.
A Jesús in jelthal an ya’ulchic ti Genesaret
Taley talbel ultsitschic a Jesús ani in exobalilchic jum poq’ue’ am pulic lejem ti tsabal Genesaret. Taja’ tats tin huic’a’ an tan tin hualte’lil am pulic lejem.
Ani lej thubat an inicchic in exla’its abal ja’its a Jesús axi calejits al an tan.
Jaxtam thubat c’alechic tim puhuel nixe’ xi tsabal quin aliy i ya’ulchic quin ne’tha’ ju’tamits ta ca xe’tsin a Jesús. Ani u chanchinal a Jesús yan i ya’ulchic, ma al i tseyte’ tat tu chi’thab.

Ju’tamaquitsq’ui ti xe’ets a Jesús max ti al i cuenchalab, max ti al i bichouchic, max ti al i alte’ q’uimath, taja’ u chanchinal ani u mo’canchab i ya’ulchic ju’ta ta ca huat’ey. Ani an ya’ulchic in lej canat ucha’ a Jesús max in ejtohual quin tacchi hue’ in acan in nacat coton. Ani patal ax in tacchal tala’ jeley.
